Question 13 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 3. What does the following function compute? int mystery(int x) { x = x | (x >> 1); x = x | (x >> 2); x = x | (x >> 4); x = x | (x >> 8); x = x | (x >> 16); return x - (x >> 1); } Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 39 Correct% 9 Your time 6 Avg time 34 Solution: The sequence x = x | (x >> 1); x = x | (x >> 2); ... propagates all set bits to the right, creating a mask of all 1s from the MSB down. Example: If x = 18 (binary 10010): x | (x >> 1) = 10010 | 01001 = 11011 x | (x >> 2) = 11011 | 00110 = 11111 Continue... we get all 1s from MSB position: 11111 (31) x - (x >> 1) = 11111 - 01111 = 10000 (16) - which is the value of the highest set bit. Answer: c) Find the highest set bit's value
options: Count the number of set bits
Find the largest power of 2 less than or equal to x
Find the highest set bit's value
answer: Find the highest set bit's value
